title: Career roadmap · Yoga Researcher
summary: Build a research career that evaluates yoga scientifically through rigorous study design, measurement, statistics, evidence synthesis, publication and translation into health, education and public programmes.

facts.Current degree: Ph.D. - Physical Education, Sports Science & Yoga
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026 Ph.D. start and an India-first research career, with later options in universities, AYUSH research institutions, health-research organisations, hospitals and international research centres. The central objective is to produce credible evidence about yoga interventions rather than treating traditional claims as established scientific findings without appropriate evidence.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Complete the Ph.D., develop strong research methods, conduct rigorous yoga studies and establish a publication record.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Build an independent niche such as mental health, chronic disease, ageing, women's health, performance, sleep or implementation science.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead multidisciplinary studies, obtain research funding, supervise researchers and translate findings into practice.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Lead a recognised yoga-research programme or centre and contribute to international evidence, clinical/public-health programmes and research policy.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Develop beyond intervention delivery into research leadership. Build expertise in reproducibility, trial methodology, implementation science, digital interventions, health economics and evidence translation while maintaining a clearly defined yoga-research niche.
For a Ph.D. student, research fellowships, project appointments and laboratory/clinical research positions are generally more useful than conventional internships.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Research Fellow/Research Associate
2030–2035: Yoga Researcher → Research Scientist → Senior Researcher
2035–2040: Senior Researcher → Principal Investigator/Research Programme Lead
2040–2046: Yoga Research Director → Research Centre Director / National Research Programme Leader
Ph.D. research routes

The strongest long-term profile will combine deep knowledge of yoga with rigorous modern research methods. By 2040, aim to lead multidisciplinary studies, secure competitive funding, supervise researchers, publish high-quality evidence and build collaborations with public-health, clinical and academic institutions. The goal is to make yoga research useful to decision-makers without overstating evidence or making unsupported therapeutic claims.
